Terms & advertising policy

The simple rules for buyers and sellers using Yɛntɔn Online. Last updated 7 November 2026.

1. What Yɛntɔn Online does

Yɛntɔn Online is a Ghanaian digital marketplace and advertising platform. We promote products and services for businesses on our website and social media pages, and connect buyers with sellers. We do not sell, own, store or deliver the products advertised, and we are not part of any sale between a buyer and a seller.

2. For buyers

  • When you contact a seller, the sale is between you and that seller. Price, payment, delivery, warranty and returns are agreed with them.
  • We do our best to check listings, but we can't guarantee that every product, price or description is accurate. Always see the item before you pay.
  • Yɛntɔn Online is not responsible for losses from a sale between a buyer and a seller. If a seller acts dishonestly, report them to us and we may remove them.
  • We will never ask you to pay for a product through us, and we will never ask for your Mobile Money PIN.

3. For sellers

  • You must give true, accurate information about your business and products, including real photos and real prices.
  • You must own, or have the right to sell, everything you advertise, and you must have the right to use the photos and videos you send us.
  • You are responsible for your sales: answering buyers, collecting payment, delivering, and honouring any promise you make.
  • You agree that we may use the photos, videos and details you send us to promote your products on our website and social media.
  • Prices, ad budgets and campaign length are agreed with our team before a campaign starts. Our management fee is shown separately from the money spent on ads.
  • We promote your product as agreed, but we can't guarantee a number of sales or enquiries.
  • If a campaign can't go ahead because your listing breaks this policy, we'll tell you before any ad money is spent. Refunds for campaigns that have not started are agreed case by case.

4. Advertising policy

Our team reviews every submission before it goes live. We don't advertise:

  • Anything illegal under Ghanaian law, or anything that needs a licence the seller doesn't have
  • Fake, counterfeit, stolen or smuggled goods
  • Weapons, ammunition and explosives
  • Drugs, unapproved medicines, and health products with false claims
  • Adult or sexual content
  • Investment schemes, "double your money", pyramid schemes and loans with hidden terms
  • Land or property without proper documents
  • Anything misleading, hateful, or that copies another business's name or brand

We may refuse, pause or remove any listing, and remove the Verified badge from any seller, if we believe it breaks this policy or harms buyers.

5. Verified badge and ratings

The ✔ Verified badge means our team has checked that a business is real at the time of checking. It is not a guarantee of every sale. Ratings come from buyers and reflect their own experience.

6. Changes

We may update these terms as our service grows. The date at the top shows the latest version.

7. Contact

Questions about these terms? Email or contact us.
